chs.name: 恶化伤口
chs.description: 精英负面魔法。 For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
chs.concise: 精英负面魔法。 如果目标敌人带有「流血」或「中毒」症状，则使其遭受 2点「生命衰减」，效果持续 1...7秒。

cht.name: 滲透傷口
cht.description: 精英降咒魔法： For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
cht.concise: 精英降咒魔法： 持續 1...7 秒，目標敵人移動速度降低 33% ，若該敵人身上有病症，則每秒造成 5...25 傷害，此技能的施展距離為普通的一半。

de.name: Eiternde Wunde
de.description: Elite-Verhexung. For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
de.concise: Elite-Verhexung. (1...7 Sekunde[n].) Gegner bewegt sich um 33% langsamer. Falls dieser Gegner an einem Zustand leidet, erleidet er außerdem 5...25 Punkt[e] Schaden pro Sekunde.

de-guildwiki.name: Eiternde Wunde
de-guildwiki.description: 1...7 Sekunden lang bewegt sich der Gegner um 33% langsamer. Wenn der Gegner unter einem Zustand leidet, erleidet er 5...25 Punkte Schaden pro Sekunde.
de-guildwiki.concise: (1...7 Sekunden.) Gegner bewegt sich um 33% langsamer. Verursacht an Feinden, die an einem Zustand leiden, 5...25 Punkte Schaden pro Sekunde.

en.name: Seeping Wound
en.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
en.concise: Elite Hex Spell. (1...7 seconds.) Target foe moves 33% slower. This foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.

en-gww.name: Seeping Wound
en-gww.description: For 1...7 second[s], target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
en-gww.concise: (1...7 second[s].) Target foe moves 33% slower. This foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.

es.name: Herida supurante
es.description: Conjuro con maleficio de élite. For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
es.concise: Conjuro con maleficio de élite. (1...7 segundos). El enemigo objetivo se mueve un 33% más despacio. Éste recibirá 5...25 de daño por segundo mientras sufra una condición.

fr.name: Plaie suintante
fr.description: Maléfice d'élite. For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
fr.concise: Maléfice d'élite. (1...7 secondes.) La cible ennemie se déplace 33% moins vite. Cet ennemi subit 5...25 points de dégâts par seconde s'il souffre d'une condition.

fr-gwiki.name: Plaie suintante
fr-gwiki.description: Pendant 1...7 secondes, la vitesse de déplacement de l'ennemi visé est réduite de 33%. Si cet ennemi souffre d'une condition, il subit 5...25 points de dégâts par seconde.

it.name: Ferita Sanguinante
it.description: Fattura d'Élite. For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
it.concise: Fattura d'Élite. (Secondo[i]: 1...7). La velocità dell'obiettivo nemico è ridotta di un 33%. Tale nemico subisce 5...25 danni al secondo se affetto da una condizione.

jp.name: シープ ウンド
jp.description: エリート弱体化スペル： For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
jp.concise: エリート弱体化スペル： (1...7 秒) ターゲットした敵は移動速度が 33% 減少します。この敵に「状態異常」がかけられている間、毎秒 5...25 のダメージを与えます。

kr.name: 증상 악화
kr.description: 엘리트 약화 마법. For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
kr.concise: 엘리트 약화 마법. (1...7초) 대상의 이동 속도를 33% 느려지게 하고, 상태이상에 걸린 적에게는 매초 5...25의 대미지를 줍니다.

pl.name: Ropiejąca Rana
pl.description: Elitarna klątwa (czar). For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
pl.concise: Elitarna klątwa (czar). (1...7 sek.) Wybrany przeciwnik porusza się 33% wolniej. Przeciwnik ten otrzymuje co sekundę 5...25 pkt. obrażeń, jeśli cierpi na jakąś przypadłość.

ru.name: Seeping Wound
ru.description: Элитное заклинание-проклятье. For 1...7 seconds, target foe moves 33% slower. That foe takes 5...25 damage each second while suffering from a condition.
ru.concise: Элитное заклинание-проклятье. (1...7 сек) Выбранный противник двигается на 33% медленнее. Этот противник получает 5...25 ед. урона каждую секунду, пока находится под действием какого-либо состояния.

bork.name: Seepeeng Vuoond
bork.description: Ileete-a Hex Spell. Fur 1...7 secunds, taerget fue-a mufes 33% slooer. Thaet fue-a taekes 5...25 daemaege-a iaech secund vheele-a sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun.
bork.concise: Ileete-a Hex Spell. (1...7 secunds.) Taerget fue-a mufes 33% slooer. Thees fue-a taekes 5...25 daemaege-a iaech secund vheele-a sooffffereeng frum a cundeeshun.
